traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The demogorgon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The demogorgon has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The demogorgon regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the demogorgon takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the demogorgon's next turn. The demogorgon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The demogorgon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mage is a 4th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The mage knows the following spells from the wizard's spell list:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d8 -1) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Thessalhydra

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thessalhydra makes one maw attack and one Flurry of Bites.

actions.name: Flurry of Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Maw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage.

actions.name: Tail Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled. As an action, the target can escape the grapple by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (its choice). Until this grapple ends, the thessalhydra can't use its tail pincer.

actions.name: Acid Saliva (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The thessalhydra spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The thessalhydra makes a Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Swipe
legendary_actions.desc: The thessalhydra makes a tail pincer attack.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 2. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.
